name: alu_insertion_analysis_v2.1.0
title: ALU Insertion Analysis v2.1.0
summary: Runs Scramble MEI detection and ALU insertion analysis on a BAM file

inputSpec.name: bed
inputSpec.label: BED file (optional)
inputSpec.help: Optional BED file to restrict analysis to specific regions

inputSpec.name: window
inputSpec.label: Coverage window size (bp)
inputSpec.help: Coverage analysis window size in bp

inputSpec.name: polyA_window
inputSpec.label: PolyA window size (bp)
inputSpec.help: PolyA detection window size in bp

inputSpec.name: threshold
inputSpec.label: Coverage change threshold (%)
inputSpec.help: Coverage change threshold as a percentage

inputSpec.name: merge_gap
inputSpec.label: Merge gap (bp)
inputSpec.help: Maximum gap for merging nearby variants

inputSpec.name: proximity
inputSpec.label: Proximity (bp)
inputSpec.help: Max distance from variant to keep coverage tract

inputSpec.name: dx_project_id
inputSpec.label: DNAnexus project ID to scan
inputSpec.help: Project ID containing R134 BAM files to scan (scan results are logged, not yet used for processing)

outputSpec.name: alu_vcf
outputSpec.label: ALU insertions VCF
outputSpec.help: VCF filtered to ALU insertions only

outputSpec.name: alu_analysis_high_confidence_csv
outputSpec.label: High confidence ALU analysis CSV
outputSpec.help: High confidence ALU analysis results (BOTH evidence)
